minutes.title: Design and Marketing Meeting
minutes.summary: The meeting discussed new remote control features for gaming. They decided to work quickly on basic functionality and user interface, with a suggestion for an ergonomic design.
topics: Marketing Expert introduced himself as Ebenezer
Adam proposed small d-pads for easy navigation
decisions: We'll work fast on deciding basic functionality and user interface
Person_1 suggested making something ergonomic, slightly different in shape.

actions.task: Design and discuss new remote control features
Write up what was quickly done and get it out to everyone
Finish this one up, take the laptop for rest of meeting
